capabilities: Fold table rows into groups and nested records using # and > markers
Edit lists, tasks, images, embeds, and code blocks directly in table cells
Resize columns by dragging separators or set widths via header metadata
Switch long tables to a compact one-line display

Create horizontal header groups with # Group
Field headers
extras: Warns that row-rewriting plugins like Advanced Tables may conflict with tree markers or width metadata; tree-aware dragging is not yet supported; author accepts donations via GitHub Sponsors.
intentEvidence: TreeTable enhances native Markdown table syntax with foldable row groups, Outliner-style cell editing, and draggable column widths.
problem: Native Markdown tables in Obsidian are flat and source-only, making hierarchical data and in-cell rich content hard to manage.
summary: Markdown table enhancer that adds foldable row groups, nested records, rich in-cell editing, and draggable column widths.
